sentence_stem: I can't come to the party tonight because
full_sentence: I can't come to the party tonight because I have to work late.
acceptable_variants: my boss asked me to stay at the office.

options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a result, but 'because' needs a reason clause. This option gives no reason.
'But' shows contrast, and 'because' needs a reason, not a contrasting wish.

options.text: I will be there at eight.
options.why_wrong: This gives a time, not a reason for missing the party.

explanation: After 'because', we need a clause that gives the reason for the first part of the sentence. Polish speakers often use a similar reason word, so they should check that the clause gives a cause, not a result.
translation: Nie mogę dziś wieczorem przyjść na imprezę, ponieważ muszę pracować do późna.
